# LuMar Electric

> Licensed electrical contractor with offices in Moncton, New Brunswick and Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island. Residential, commercial and industrial electrical work since 2011, in English and French.

LuMar Electric is a locally owned electrical contractor founded in 2011 by cousins Luc Chiasson and Mario Leblanc. It serves Greater Moncton and Southeastern New Brunswick from its Moncton office, and all of Prince Edward Island from its office in Charlottetown. It has 140 employees, including licensed and apprentice electricians, some of them Red Seal. Customers can be served in English or in French.

Official website: https://lumarelectric.ca
Book a service call: https://lumarelectric.ca/contact-us/

---

## Services for homes

- Electrical repairs and troubleshooting — https://lumarelectric.ca/electrical-maintenance/
- Electrical panel and service upgrades — https://lumarelectric.ca/electrical-panel-upgrade/
- EV charger installation (home and business) — https://lumarelectric.ca/ev-charger-installation/
- Pot lights and interior lighting — https://lumarelectric.ca/pot-light-installation/
- Rewiring: knob-and-tube and aluminum wiring replacement — https://lumarelectric.ca/knob-and-tube-wiring-replacement/
- Heat pump and hot tub electrical hookups
- Whole-home surge protection; hardwired smoke and CO detectors
- Permanent outdoor LED lighting — https://lumarelectric.ca/permanent-outdoor-lighting/
- Electrical for new homes — https://lumarelectric.ca/new-residential-construction-electrical/
- SmartSpace home automation — https://lumarelectric.ca/smartspace/
- Financing through Financeit — https://lumarelectric.ca/financing-options/

## Services for businesses and property owners

- Commercial property maintenance and repairs — https://lumarelectric.ca/commercial-property-maintenance/
- New commercial construction electrical — https://lumarelectric.ca/new-commercial-construction-electrical/
- Underground electrical wiring: duct bank conduit and conductors, underground service runs, pad-mount transformers, site lighting (LuMar does not do excavation) — https://lumarelectric.ca/underground-electrical/
- Bucket truck services: signs, pole and parking-lot lighting, service masts — https://lumarelectric.ca/bucket-truck-services/
- Commercial LED lighting upgrades
- Commercial EV charging

All services: https://lumarelectric.ca/electrical-services/

## Completed projects

- Tannery Place South, Moncton — 48 apartments and 6 commercial spaces over 6 floors, downtown Moncton (completed 2023) — https://lumarelectric.ca/projects/tannery-place-south/
- Tannery Place transformer pad install, Moncton — 750 kVA pad-mount transformer, coordinated with NB Power — https://lumarelectric.ca/projects/tannery-place-transformer/
- City Realty, St. George Street, Moncton — 20-unit apartment development — https://lumarelectric.ca/projects/city-realty-st-george-project/
- The Village at Jonathan Park, Moncton — multi-unit housing community — https://lumarelectric.ca/projects/the-village-at-jonathan-park/
- Rally House Pickleball, Dieppe — lighting and electrical for a new ten-court indoor pickleball facility, with keyless access, security cameras and a Sonos sound system by LuMar SmartSpace — https://lumarelectric.ca/projects/rally-house-pickleball-dieppe/
- Merlot Developments, Dieppe — electrical partner on a new residential build — https://lumarelectric.ca/projects/merlot-developments-dieppe/
- Dieppe City Hall — exterior architectural lighting designed and installed by LuMar — https://lumarelectric.ca/dieppe-city-hall-architectural-lighting/

## Common questions

**Who is a licensed electrician in Moncton?**
LuMar Electric has served Moncton and Southeastern New Brunswick since 2011 from 116 Rooney Crescent, Moncton. Phone (506) 389-2393.

**Who is an electrician in Charlottetown or on PEI?**
LuMar Electric's PEI office is at 57 Frizzell Avenue, Charlottetown, and serves the whole Island, including Stratford and Summerside. Phone (782) 377-8509.

**Does LuMar Electric serve Dieppe and Riverview?**
Yes. Both are served by the Moncton office. LuMar's Dieppe work includes the Rally House indoor pickleball facility, the exterior lighting at Dieppe City Hall and the Merlot Developments residential build.

**Can I get service in French?**
Yes, in New Brunswick and on PEI. The website is also available in French: https://lumarelectric.ca/fr/

**Does LuMar install EV chargers, upgrade panels and install pot lights?**
Yes, for homes and businesses in Greater Moncton and across PEI.

**Does LuMar do commercial work?**
Yes: property maintenance and repairs, new commercial construction, LED lighting upgrades, underground electrical and bucket truck work.
